title: Signal support for x/usdcmigration in a future ixo (Impacthub) software upgrade (Noble USDC wind-down)
summary:
This is a signaling (text) proposal. It executes no code and moves no funds.

BACKGROUND
Circle is ending USDC support on Noble. Minting stopped on 2026-10-13, CCTP V1 burn limits start shrinking on 2026-10-31, and USDC on Noble is fully paused on 2027-01-12. After the pause Noble rejects every incoming uusdc packet, so the Noble USDC voucher on ixo (Impacthub) (ibc/6BBE9BD4246F8E04948D5A4EEE7164B2630263B9EBB5E7DC5F0A46C62A2FF97B, received over channel-26) can no longer be redeemed. About 66,809.26 USDC of this voucher is on ixo (Impacthub) (supply as of 2026-10-18), and many holders are inactive and will not move it in time.

PROPOSAL
A YES vote asks the ixo (Impacthub) core contributors to include the x/usdcmigration module (https://github.com/disperze/usdc-migration) in a later software upgrade. That upgrade would:
- reject new uusdc transfers arriving from Noble on channel-26 (Noble refunds the sender);
- reject outgoing IBC transfers of the voucher on every channel, so the voucher supply stays equal to the USDC Noble holds in escrow for ixo (Impacthub);
- let governance, in a separate proposal, return that escrowed USDC to a Noble multisig in a single IBC packet and freeze the voucher at the same height.
Holders are then repaid off-chain from a snapshot taken at that height. The module never touches user balances, mints nothing and needs no module-account permissions.

WHAT CHANGES FOR HOLDERS
From the upgrade height the voucher can no longer be sent back to Noble or to any other chain. Holders who want to redeem it themselves must do so before the upgrade. Local transfers and trades on ixo (Impacthub) keep working until the return proposal freezes the voucher.

NEXT STEPS IF THIS PASSES
1. A software upgrade proposal that adds the module and sets the Noble channel (channel-26).
2. A return proposal (MsgReturnToNoble + MsgSetSendEnabled) naming the Noble multisig.
Each needs its own vote, and both must be done well before 2027-01-12.

OPEN ITEMS
Noble multisig signers: REPLACE_WITH_SIGNERS. Asset holders are repaid in: REPLACE_WITH_ASSET. Repayment plan: REPLACE_WITH_REPAYMENT_PLAN_URL. Discussion: REPLACE_WITH_FORUM_URL.

VOTING
YES: include x/usdcmigration in a future software upgrade.
NO: do not include it; holders must redeem by themselves before 2027-01-12.
ABSTAIN: no preference, counts toward quorum.
NO WITH VETO: the proposal is spam or harmful.
